text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Yayyy! I got one! I really got one!
Thanks for coming with me, Bourbon!
The store was so crowded because of
the sale. You must be
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My physical stamina and energy levels
are fine, and I've detected no issues as a
result of the sale.
We have accomplished
our objective.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Um... But still, I'm sorry. That
wasn't
much fun, was it? I mean, I
haven't seen you smile
at all today...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
No, it's okay! You don't have to say
anything.
Thanks for coming with me! I'll
see ya next time!
Sorry again!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. It appears she determined
that I was
"bored" due to my expression.
However, that
conclusion is inaccurate.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I completed a difficulty C objective,
securing an item on sale, which also let
me see my friend smile. Therefore, the
answer to your question is
"yes."
choice_data_list: You really had a great time, huh.
You really had a great time, didn'...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder. Past experience suggests an
eighty
percent probability that the same
situation will
occur again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The next time is likely to be... at the
costume
party.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That video was just so adorable! We
should throw
a costume party, just like
the one in the video!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see. I'm pleased you appear to be
enjoying
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, just thinking up costume
ideas is
super fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And, um... the party prep and the party
itself are
gonna be super fun too, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-would you like to come?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I agreed at the time, but I have
determined that there is a high
probability of my presence
dampening
the mood.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I had better decline after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon bows slightly and walks
off
towards the school building.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, what's with that gloomy face?
Is
something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'd be more than happy to lend
you an ear. ♪ If something's troubling
you, a problem
shared is a problem
halved.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So that's how Bourbon is feeling?
I'm
planning to attend the costume party
myself,
but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Right. You can leave this all to me. I'll
speak with Bourbon. After all, the more
people that come to
the party, the more
fun it'll be!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bourrrbon.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well done with your training. By the
way, I heard
you're worried about the
costume party.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...You're also attending, correct?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I am. The party's called "The More the
Scarier." ♪
So won't you join us,
Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But, I...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Rice invited you to the party because
you're a
very special friend to her. And
to me too, of
course.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're not the slightest bit boring. In
fact, if you
don't come, I'll miss you so
much I might even
cry...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will optimize my conduct
for the
event: ensure that my expression
remains jovial,
and—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, no. You'll be perfectly fine
just as you
are. Forcing yourself to smile
is very much a
no-no.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But if I don't...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine as I am? Without any... special
changes?
choice_data_list: I think you're fine just the way y...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order for everyone to enjoy the party,
it's probably best for Mihono Bourbon to
just be herself. That way she can relax
and have a good
time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's right. There's no need to
overthink it. We all want to party with
the usual Bourbon we all
know and
love. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The usual me...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Acknowledged. I'll research an
appropriate
costume and make it as
soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone can offer to help, Mihono
Bourbon
dashes off at astonishing speed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's a nice idea too. A costume
doesn't need to transform yourself
entirely, after all. It's
just as much fun to
think of a costume that's just right for
you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You mean... a cyborg costume?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That would be wonderful as well.
I'm sure
you'd make a very strong and
cool cyborg. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Commencing search for a
suitable
costume. I will accomplish this
mission no matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although the goal is simply to have a
good time,
Mihono Bourbon faces her
mission with steadfast
determination.
